# Contributing

1. Follow the [documentation for setting up a Codespaces-based developer environment](https://github.com/github/code-scanning/blob/main/docs/running-your-own-instance.md).
1. Make your changes on a branch.
1. Submit a PR. Reviewers will be automatically assigned by `CODEOWNERS`.
1. Come back a bit later to read and deal with review comments.
1. Get an approval.
1. Click the "Merge when ready" button to use the GitHub Merge Queue to deploy to production.
1. Check the deployment: use the links in the Slack deployment message to check that DataDog dashboards and Sentry errors look normal.
1. The PR will auto merge once the deployment is done.
